requirement_evidence.evidence: Extract rejects invalid UTF-8 text. validKey rejects empty or invalid UTF-8 keys, Unicode whitespace/control, @, backslash and backtick. Literal string matching preserves case and normalization. Registered keys are copied into local storage without modifying the caller's slice.

mentionStart decodes the preceding rune and rejects letters, numbers, marks, underscore, hyphen, dot, plus and @. Candidate suffixes are decoded and checked with identifierRune. Extract chooses the longest boundary-valid literal prefix and advances past it; trailing period and plus remain permitted punctuation.

Extract scans lines and positions in source order. The local registered map removes duplicate registrations; the local seen map appends each selected key only on its first eligible occurrence. No matches return nil.

The inline scanner counts complete backtick runs. codeLength opens on any run and clears only on an exactly equal run. Mentions are skipped while codeLength is nonzero. codeLength resets for each line, so unmatched spans hide only that line's remainder.

fenceStart accepts only zero to three ASCII spaces before a backtick or tilde run. Runs of at least three open fences with arbitrary tails. Closing requires the same character, sufficient run length and a tail containing only spaces/tabs. Fence lines/content are skipped; LF splitting removes CR from CRLF.

Quoted lines are skipped before fence handling using TrimLeft with ASCII spaces/tabs and a leading > check. mentionStart rejects odd consecutive backslash counts before applying the left boundary. Email-shaped prefixes fail that boundary. Ordinary quote marks receive no special handling.

Route maps Human Pending to start, Busy to soon and Finished to new. It calls Extract and builds exactly one Delivery for each returned key in the same order. Empty extraction produces zero deliveries without an implicit target.

Route permits Agent only when state equals Busy and assigns soon. Unknown authors and unknown human states return nil; all other agent states return nil. Every constructed delivery comes directly from Extract. Extract has no state or author dependency.
